title: Vectored Conversational AI Testing: Structured  testing for free‑flowing AI conversations. | Product Hunt
excerpt: Vectored Conversational AI Testing is a behavioural methodology for evaluating AI through structured, multi‑turn dialogue. It wraps free‑flowing conversation in a repeatable, auditable test framework and surfaces drift, recovery, escalation, and failure across full conversational arcs. Built for developers, auditors, and governance teams, it complements the LLM Inquisitor methodology.

content_html_zh: 矢量对话式 AI 测试是一种通过结构化、多轮对话评估 AI 的行为方法。 它将自由流动的对话包装在可重复、可审计的测试框架中，并在整个对话弧上显示漂移、恢复、升级和失败。 它专为开发人员、审计人员和治理团队而构建，是对 LLM Inquisitor 方法的补充。
